Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Wood directing Earth broadly — reach ranging across stable material
candidates.k2_overview: Your Earth moves as the Horizon: ground that acquires. You accumulate opportunity the way land accumulates value, steadily, tangibly, with paperwork. Your ventures have foundations, your windfalls become holdings, and your generosity comes deeded. Fortune trusts you because you give it somewhere to live.
candidates.k2_functional: You acquire deliberately: surveyed chances, patient closings, ownership that sticks.

k2_domain_readings.Opportunity: Your opportunities are tangible: property, inventory, businesses with floors and keys. You distrust vapor correctly. Walk the ground before buying it, and buy ground more often than promises.
k2_domain_readings.Ventures: Your ventures should hold weight: real assets, real product, margins you can stack. Compound patiently. In your hands, boring holdings quietly outperform everyone’s exciting stories.
k2_domain_readings.Father: The father-thread is foundational: a paternal figure tied to property, provision, or their weighty absence. What he built or failed to build shaped your acquiring. Build yours on your own survey.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, firm ground is scarce and you see good fields everywhere with little seed for any of them. What you gain passes on through your hands.

angles.drive: You see a chance long before anyone else wants it. Having somewhere next to go is your safety, so you watch where a thing is heading more than what it is. By the time others see the opening, you are already there.
angles.cost_self: Looking far comes naturally, and it pays. The next place is clearer to you than this one, so you notice the far chance more than the near one. The opening right in front of you is the one you walk past most.
angles.cost_others: You look past the people closest to you toward the next place. Seeing far is how you keep them safe, and that gives the plan more of you than them. They get the future you are building and less of you today.

angles.drive: A chance within reach is hard to leave alone, because standing in place feels like losing. You take the one that is here rather than wait for a safer one. The doors you walk through are ones most people only look at.
angles.cost_self: Taking the chance pays you more than waiting does. Moving makes you feel alive, so you put money into what moves rather than what is safe. The bad bets cost you the money the dull ones would have kept.
angles.cost_others: You take the chance for everyone whose money sits beside yours. Moving feels safer to you than staying, and you put their calm into the venture with your own. Their peace of mind rises and falls with your next move.

angles.drive: A win only feels real to you once you have shared it. Providing is where you feel most yourself, and you share a good month rather than put it away. In a good year, everyone at your table eats well.
angles.cost_self: Sharing the win is your natural generosity, and it leaves you short. What you give in a good year you lack in a lean one, because giving comes before keeping. Your own cushion never gets the chance to grow.
angles.cost_others: You share each win rather than sit on it. Giving in bursts is your way of loving, and you hand the people around you plenty one year and nothing the next. Nobody near you ever doubts where your heart is.

friction.define: As a friction, more comes within reach than you can hold, because something new is what lifts you. Much of what you gain slips away before it pays.

angles.drive: The next chance always looks better to you than the one in your hands. Movement is how you feel alive, and you chase what is coming rather than work what is here. You only keep what you stay long enough to collect.
angles.cost_self: Chasing the next chance costs you the one you hold now. Each new start takes the strength the last one needs, and you would rather begin again than finish. You let the chance in your hands close while you are off chasing.
angles.cost_others: You chase the next chance before anyone is out of the last one. You want starting more than staying, and you give the new venture what you owed the old one. You put the unfinished work of the old venture on your partners.

angles.drive: You are spread so thin that no one thing gets enough of you. Saying no feels like losing, so you hold many small pieces rather than one whole thing. You have every right to drop a few and give one your all.
angles.cost_self: Spreading yourself thin feels safer than betting on one thing, and it keeps you tired. You give each venture enough to stay in rather than enough to win, since quitting feels like losing. You are allowed to end one and call it a choice.
angles.cost_others: Wherever you can reach, you spread yourself across every person and plan. Keeping every option alive matters more to you than giving one your whole attention. You offer each person and plan a slice of you too thin to count on.

angles.drive: Starting a thing gives you more than finishing it. The beginning is where the feeling lives, and you spend your strength there rather than on the last stretch. You get nothing for the half until the rest is done.
angles.cost_self: Finishing is what you save for later. The last stretch costs you more than the first, and you would rather open a new thing than close an old one. You leave the money and the credit sitting at the end you skip.
angles.cost_others: You hand people a beginning and call it done. Starting is where you feel strongest, and you put everything into the first stretch instead of saving some for the last. You give the people waiting your start and somebody else's finish.

edge.lead: Earth runs through your wealth, your family and your social life. It is the chance you spot while it is still far off, the good year that becomes a gift for everyone at home, and the luck you hand round before it has cooled.
